en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘The man who gives charity to his children with a charity, and they are small. Is it for him that he retracts with regards to it?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No! The charity is for the Sake of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Jamil who has narrated the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,

about the case of a man who gives charity (which is not obligatory) to his small children; if he can take it back. He (the Imam) said, ‘No, because charity is for Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious.’”
